messages.author: 0febc6417116ca18
messages.subject: Getting error with AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType command
parts:
Hi,

I am getting the error: Error: attempt to apply non-function when I run the command: cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("HG_U95Av2"). Not sure what is going on. The command was working about an hour ago but it is now giving me this error. 

Thanks

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Getting error with AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType command
parts:
You probably meant:

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("HG_U95Av2")

The fromChipType() method was deprecated a long time ago and
eventually also removed.

/Henrik
